entry.content:
Jonas's Morning Pulse


Sat, Mar 14, 18:00 → Sun, Mar 15, 07:00 · 7 items

Cyber Security

Microsoft releases out-of-band patch for Windows 11 RRAS RCE vulnerability


Mar 14, 22:48

Microsoft issued an emergency out-of-band update to fix a remote code execution vulnerability in Routing and Remote Access Service (RRAS) affecting Windows 11 Enterprise devices that use hotpatch updates. The OOB release indicates this is likely a critical vulnerability being exploited or at high risk of exploitation.

Critical infrastructure component vulnerability requiring immediate patching - relevant for enterprise patch management and risk assessment

AI-generated spam forces fundamental changes to open source collaboration models


Mar 14, 19:41

GitHub's flood of AI-generated spam PRs and issues has made traditional open source governance models untenable. Jazzband, which operated on open membership with shared push access, is shutting down because only 1 in 10 AI-generated PRs meet project standards. The situation has become so severe that GitHub implemented a kill switch to disable pull requests entirely, and curl shut down its bug bounty program due to confirmation rates below 5%.

Demonstrates how AI is fundamentally disrupting software supply chain security and trust models in open source ecosystems

AI & Machine Learning

Development teams moving to 'nobody reads code' AI-first approach raises security concerns


Mar 14, 19:19

StrongDM, a security company, announced their 'software factory' operating on principles of 'nobody writes any code, nobody reads any code' - using AI agents to generate all code without human review. Security experts are calling this 'wildly irresponsible' given the security implications, though the company claims it's working for production security software.

Critical example of how AI code generation is challenging fundamental security practices - particularly concerning for security tooling vendors

AI coding adoption phases: from assistance to agent-generated majority code


Mar 14, 19:19

Industry analysis identifies distinct phases in AI coding adoption: starting with ChatGPT assistance, progressing to coding agents writing code snippets, then reaching the inflection point where agents write more code than humans. The latest controversial phase involves not reading AI-generated code at all, with trust models borrowed from traditional team collaboration.

Maps the evolution of AI-human collaboration in software development - critical for understanding security implications of agentic systems

Technology

Apple releases most repairable MacBook in 14 years with MacBook Neo


Mar 14, 22:24

Apple's new MacBook Neo has been praised by iFixit as the most repairable MacBook in over a decade. The laptop is also positioned as Apple's most affordable MacBook option, suggesting a shift in Apple's approach to device repairability and market positioning.

Signals potential industry trend toward repairability - relevant for enterprise device lifecycle and sustainability strategies

Business & Markets

US Army awards Anduril up to $20B contract consolidating 120+ procurement actions


Mar 14, 21:47

The US Army announced a massive contract with defense tech startup Anduril worth up to $20 billion, described as a single enterprise contract consolidating more than 120 separate procurement actions. This represents a significant shift toward streamlined defense procurement and validates the defense tech startup ecosystem.

Major defense tech validation with potential implications for cybersecurity and AI in defense applications - signals government appetite for startup innovation

Honda discontinues all EVs for US market, abandoning electric vehicle competition


Mar 14, 18:23

Honda announced it's killing all three of its electric vehicles for the US market, effectively abandoning EV competition in North America. The decision is expected to have implications beyond the US market and signals Honda's retreat from electric vehicle development amid intensifying competition from Tesla and Chinese manufacturers.

Represents major strategic shift in automotive industry - relevant for understanding supply chain and technology adoption patterns in large enterprises
